source: Aseprite Trial 1.3.18.6 (AppImage, observed black box) under its own Xvfb 1600x1000, screen_scale 2, 800 % zoom (16 screen px per cell), centre of each cell; driven by docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_rotacao.py over trial_selecao.py (xdotool; quirks in its docstring). Aseprite/LibreSprite source never read.
method: each input = 32x24 transparent canvas with ONE full block of distinct colours (id 1..w*h, row-major); Ctrl+A, Ctrl+T (box = the block), algorithm combo, fields Angle then Skew (positive angle = CCW on screen), Enter. Output ids: id of the source cell, 0 = transparent (checker), -1 = colour of no input (then rgb rows).
command: python3 -I docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_rotacao.py ase <dir> && python3 -I docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_rotacao.py run <dir> :83 && python3 -I docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_rotacao.py fixture <dir> <this file>
